name: anim_hira_emerge
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls
desc: Emerging slowly and stickily from a flat paint puddle, keeping the horse man's shape the whole time: the puddle bulges up, thick goo stretches upward with sticky strands, the goo rises already shaped like his huge chest and broad shoulders with the long horse head and the spiky dripping mane, all covered in thick sagging paint, the shapes getting clearer as it rises. The eyes are not there at all: the eye area stays smooth paint covered in goo until the very end. The arms start melted onto the sides of the body and slowly peel away from it, many thick sticky strands of goo stretching between the arms and the torso, sagging and drooping as the gap widens, until the arms hang free. The mouth opens into a toothy grin, then in the final frames the eyes suddenly snap open, and the legs pull up out of the goo into straight human legs, ending in the standing pose. Heavy, viscous, slow, glossy goo dripping down the whole time.
